FN-W17TGE9-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 398
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Bill Lamb
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/10/2026
House Bill 398 as introduced would decrease sales tax receipts to the following funds by the
following estimated amounts, beginning in Fiscal Year 2027, by exempting High Socks for
Hope from payment of state, county, and municipal sales and use taxes:
Education Trust Fund $1,910
County Funds $2,870
Municipal Funds $1,440
Total $6,220
Page 1

FN-W17TGE9-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 398
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Bill Lamb
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/11/2026
House Bill 398 as reported by the committee on Ways and Means Education would decrease
sales tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund by an estimated $1,910 annually, beginning in
Fiscal Year 2027, based on information provided by the entity, by exempting High Socks for
Hope from payment of state sales and use taxes.
This bill could also decrease sales tax receipts to the following funds by the following estimated
amounts, beginning in Fiscal Year 2027, based on information provided by the entity, if the
respective local governments adopt an exemption from local sales and use taxes, pursuant to this
bill:
County Funds $2,870
Municipal Funds $1,440
Page 1
